answer: Downstream coin taint freezes a whole farm's earnings once any seat is proven fake. Every payout carries a 40-epoch provenance tag on the ledger; if graders prove one seat a clone, merchants and swaps refuse every coin tagged to that seat or to addresses that received from it within 3 hops. So N fakes put N times their earned balance at risk of becoming unspendable, and mixing through fresh wallets fails because the hops stay on-ledger. An honest seat spends clean coin whether it quotes a cliff ledge repair, prices velvet cloth, or calibrates a prism spectrometer.
